method: Direct native Windows GUI; one generation followed by one saved-file reopening for every case. Files transferred through the UTM guest file agent, never generated by an assembly harness.

comparison.generation: All workbook cells and XML trees; generated random draws normalized only after validating alphabet, length, prefix, mode, grouping, order and uniqueness.
comparison.reopening: Each native saved XLSX and XML is byte-identical after reopening without regeneration. Browser XML is byte-exact; all browser workbook cell values match.

screenshots: Four captures per case retain the entire native dialog, cropped from the host screenshot and resized to 1000 px height. Unmodified host captures remain in the local working directory.
excludedAttempts: Initial controller attempts for M002 and M003 used stale primitive closure state and selected incorrect prefixes. They were excluded, the input files restored byte-for-byte, and both cases repeated with the shared-state controller. This was a test-controller fault, not a product discrepancy.
limits: Synthetic original-template inputs, no empirical study files.
Finite 128-case option product, not arbitrary lengths, files, network states or complete application equivalence.
Randomly generated individual codes are not expected to be identical between independent generations.
